name: List Agents
description: Lists all agents owned by the authenticated user, with a status summary for each. Terminated agents are hidden by default.

includeTerminated.description: If true, include TERMINATED agents in the listing. Default false.

awaiting.description: Pending jobs awaiting input or authorisation; derived on read from this agent's pending job references, independent of lifecycle status. Does not imply the viewer is the intended responder.
